The November 10 report notes Harbaugh's attorney expected him to fly with the team to Penn State [5]. A post-game report also confirms Harbaugh was prohibited from being on the field for the final three regular-season games [6] and that Moore served as acting coach [7]. The evidence is consistent that Harbaugh was absent from coaching duties on November 11, 2023, despite initial uncertainty about his travel plans.
